Hi Sanjay — great to hear you're moving forward. Short answers first: yes, we can provide an explicit no-training (no-model-improvement) commitment scoped to the pilot dataset and timeframe, and yes, outputs (prompts + responses) can be covered by a customer-output license that prevents Redwood from using them to improve our models.

I've attached a draft DPA addendum that:
- Adds a temporary no-training clause for the pilot period (30 days by default; can be extended)
- Defines "Customer Data" to include prompts and model responses produced during the pilot and grants Valencia a non-exclusive ownership/rights carveout for those outputs
- Specifies operational controls: ephemeral inference sessions (KV cache retention <= 5 minutes by default), session-level audit logs retained for 90 days, and on-request export of logs for compliance review

Attachments: redwood-dpa-amendment_no-train_v1.pdf (PDF), ephemeral-inference-ops-runbook.docx (DOCX).

If that looks reasonable, I'd like to loop in our legal (Kimberly) and product (Marissa) to confirm the operational and wording details. We can push a redline into DocuSign after a quick internal review and your team signs off.

Next steps: I'll send an internal thread to get legal/product sign-off and update you within 48 hours.

Best,

- Narrow the definition of "Model Improvement" to exclude internal telemetry used only for platform reliability (to avoid overly broad interpretations).
- Add a clause that requires Redwood to notify Valencia prior to providing any aggregated, de-identified telemetry to third-party research projects (so we have a notification channel).
- Clarify the export SLA: 5 business days to provide audit-log export to Valencia's security team; support SFTP or signed URL depending on Valencia's policy.

Operational feasibility: Marissa confirms we can deliver KV retention <= 5 minutes for this pilot and retain session-level logs for 90 days in the hosted region (US-west). David confirms logs can be exported via signed, time-limited URLs or SFTP and that we can prove residency in US-west for the export.
